passives.name: Lit the Fuse
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When attacking while granted a buff, inflicts Burned on all enemies for 2 turns. Additionally, reduces damage taken from enemies inflicted with Burned by 70%.

passives.name: Blessing of the Tower of Flames
passives.description: Penetration is always increased by 20% and Critical Hit Chance by 10%. Damage taken is reduced by 20%. At end of turn, reduces the enemy team’s CP by 25.
